adoption_basis.description: Outcome-informed hypothesis confirmation on untouched targets from source modules absent from the pilot. The exploratory pilot selected the hypothesis; its blind governance supplies only an N=200 rationale, and pilot observations are never pooled into confirmation estimates or tests.

pilot_sympy_governance.role: outcome-blind N=200 rationale from the ungated candidate-pool projection; not a formal power or precision guarantee for the source-gated confirmation population

scope.claim_population: fresh structurally E2-eligible SymPy targets from source modules absent from the pilot, selected by the frozen candidate-table design

sample.sampler: build_sample_plan(full_candidates, 200, exclude_keys=source_ineligible_keys union every candidate key whose identity[0] is one of the 19 pilot modules union exact pilot keys); full-table cutpoints, strata, validation, and frozen priorities are retained
sample.strata: original full-table body-length tercile x module-in-degree tercile x cohort, 18 cells
sample.allocation: proportional Hamilton with frozen priority and no discretionary replacement
sample.governance_population_difference: the blinded governance projected module sizes from the full candidate table excluding only pilot targets; this confirmation first restricts to the source-eligible E2 population and excludes every pilot source module, so N=200 is a fixed rationale and actual-plan cluster support plus realized halfwidth, not the old projection, controls claimability
sample.pre_score_cluster_gate: after the deterministic draw and before any model score, require at least 20 distinct identity[0] modules and N^2/sum(n_g^2) >= 10; otherwise abort the sealed study without replacement

source_eligibility_gate.predicate: both maximal renderer-equivalent byte strings have rendering_bytes >= 16384 and therefore assembly eligible=true; the UTF-8-valid suffix may contain up to three fewer bytes when the byte cut splits a scalar
source_eligibility_gate.computation: sharded exact length-only reconstruction of the frozen k4 dependency and k5 seed-0 random-nondependency renderings; no BM25, unrelated arm, tokenizer, model, NLL, or outcome is evaluated

bindings.renderer_and_seed_code: bound by the later confirmation implementation-freeze artifact before the census

source_eligibility_gate.cross_check: the length-only decision and byte totals must equal the full assembly renderer on adversarial fixtures and a committed deterministic source-only audit sample
source_eligibility_gate.output: sorted eligible identity keys, sorted ineligibility reasons, exact rendering byte totals, per-shard hashes, full eligible count/key hash, exact pilot-key intersection count/key hash, exact pilot-module candidate count/key hash, module-disjoint post-pilot eligible count/key hash, and a complete 19926-candidate coverage hash
source_eligibility_gate.shard_reducer: every candidate appears in exactly one fragment; fragment ranges are disjoint and their union is the exact sorted 19926-key universe; any missing, overlapping, malformed, or unresolved row aborts the entire census

pilot_intersection_expected_from_sealed_.meaning: audit expectation only; reducer recomputes and fail-closes on disagreement

source_eligibility_gate.pilot_module_exclusion: exclude every candidate whose identity[0] occurs among the exact 19 pilot modules, so pilot and confirmation are disjoint at the modeled dependence unit

instrument_gate.per_model_evidence: write-once frozen production-path battery bound to exact model, revision, tokenizer files, numerical harness, environment, source tree, dtype, device, attention implementation, chunk size, context length, repeat determinism, causal masking, token-byte conservation, and peak memory
instrument_gate.failure_rule: no confirmation scoring and no model substitution

primary.positive_direction: known dependency context has lower body BPB than equal-budget frozen random nondependency context
success_requires: all provenance, execution, cluster-support, degeneracy, and precision gates pass

inference.estimator: unequal-cluster one-way random-effects method-of-moments used by v2b_n_governance
inference.degeneracy_tolerance: tol=64*ulp(max(1,max_abs_delta)); inference is degenerate when delta range <= tol OR SE <= tol
inference.student_t_implementation: frozen and tested for every possible integer df 1..199; all means, SEs, Student-t CDFs, confidence bounds, p-values, Holm comparisons, and labels use unrounded binary64 values, with rounding only for display

secondary_gate.method: Holm step-down FWER 0.05 with ties broken by exact endpoint id; an inferentially unavailable endpoint remains in the five-endpoint family with raw p=1

endpoint_labels.descriptive-gate-closed: primary was not confirmed, so no secondary confirmatory claim is evaluated
endpoint_labels.secondary-inference-unavailable: endpoint remains in Holm with p=1 because its frozen inference or support gate is unavailable
endpoint_labels.secondary-precision-not-met: inference is available but the realized two-sided 95% halfwidth exceeds 0.02
endpoint_labels.secondary-positive-supported: one-sided endpoint passes support, degeneracy, precision, and Holm-adjusted p<=0.05
endpoint_labels.secondary-nonzero-supported: two-sided slope endpoint passes support, degeneracy, precision, and Holm-adjusted p<=0.05
endpoint_labels.secondary-null-not-rejected: available endpoint does not meet its applicable supported label

endpoints.eligibility: same fresh target has k1 and k4:16384 scores at q25c-1.5b
endpoints.inference: same module-MoM estimator and claimability gates as primary

endpoints.eligibility: same fixed 200-target cohort has k4:16384 and k5:0:16384 scores at q25c-0.5b
endpoints.inference: same module-MoM estimator and claimability gates as primary

endpoints.eligibility: same fixed 200-target cohort has k4:16384 and k5:0:16384 scores at q25c-3b
endpoints.inference: same module-MoM estimator and claimability gates as primary

endpoints.eligibility: same fixed 200-target cohort has k4:16384 and k5:0:16384 scores at q25c-7b
endpoints.inference: same module-MoM estimator and claimability gates as primary

endpoints.eligibility: same target has seed-0 E2 scores at all four checkpoints
endpoints.inference: one frozen OLS slope per target followed by the same module-MoM estimator and claimability gates

model_size_trend.complete_case_population: targets E2-eligible and successfully scored at all four checkpoints
model_size_trend.x: log2 nominal parameter billions in fixed model order [0.5,1.5,3,7]
model_size_trend.unit: E2 bits-per-byte per nominal model-size doubling
model_size_trend.inference: one slope per target, followed by the same module-MoM estimator

reports: mean and two-sided 95% interval at each checkpoint
E1a one-sided lower bound on the exact E1a/E1b intersection

label_rules.descriptive-inference-unavailable: either E1b or intersection E1a inference is unavailable
label_rules.descriptive-interface-compatibility-patt: on the exact common target intersection, one-sided U95(E1b) < 0.02 AND one-sided L95(E1a) > 0

k5_seed_sensitivity.common_case_requirement: k4 and all three k5 seeds structurally eligible and successfully scored
k5_seed_sensitivity.target_level_seed_standard_deviation: ordinary sample standard deviation across the three per-target seed deltas with denominator 2
k5_seed_sensitivity.aggregation: compute each seed mean and the mean target-level three-seed average with equal target weights on the exact common-case population; report the arithmetic range of the three seed means and the mean target-level sample standard deviation
k5_seed_sensitivity.direction_stable: all three seed-specific means are positive

blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.salt: new confirmation-only 32-byte cryptographic random salt, stored once outside Git as a regular non-symlink mode-0600 file; the pilot salt is forbidden
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.public_commitment: SHA256 of the exact 32 salt bytes, committed before scoring and proven an ancestor of every target-score artifact; no salt reroll is allowed
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.family_id: fam- plus the first 16 lowercase hex characters of HMAC-SHA256(salt, canonical JSON [family_domain,study_id,model_id,contrast_id])
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.fixed_width_ciphertext: for each model, contrast, and target, plaintext is the IEEE-754 binary64 delta encoded as exactly 8 big-endian bytes when structurally eligible and +0.0 encoded the same way when ineligible padding; XOR it with the first 8 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(salt, canonical JSON [payload_domain,study_id,model_id,contrast_id,target_key]) and publish exactly 16 lowercase hex characters
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.masked_coverage: exactly 200 target keys x four model ids x five opaque contrast families, one fixed-width ciphertext per row; eligibility and padding status are absent from the masked row, so family sizes do not reveal the mapping
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.post_reveal_filter: after authenticated decryption and family mapping, the analyzer includes all 200 E1a/E2_seed0 rows and includes E1b/E2_seed1/E2_seed2 rows iff the separately committed pre-score assembly eligibility ledger marks every required cell eligible; +0.0 padding is never an observation and never enters a mean, interval, p-value, or label
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.fixed_n_completeness_gate: before reveal, verify exact same 200 targets x four models x six registered cell records and exactly 200 x four x five fixed-width masked ciphertext rows; k1, k4:16384, and k5:0:16384 must be eligible and scored for all 200, while k3:16384 and k5:1/2:16384 must be scored for every and only their frozen structurally eligible keys and explicitly recorded ineligible otherwise; also verify all target/model/study completion evidence, deterministic replay, batteries, protocol/freeze/source bindings, and zero extra/missing files without inspecting ciphertext, salt, eligibility-to-family mapping, or numerical values
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.failure_rule: any missing target/model/cell record, missing score for a structurally eligible cell, score for an ineligible cell, or binding failure makes the whole confirmation execution-incomplete-not-analyzed; structural ineligibility of a diagnostic cell is registered missing-by-design rather than an execution failure; no partial-N primary, redraw, replacement, variance reprojection, or alternate salt
blinding_and_fixed_n_gate.one_reveal: after the fixed-N gate and committed analyzer/freeze, exactly one registered reveal maps opaque families and signs

execution_schema_contracts.cell_enumerator: exact ordered cells [k1,k3:16384,k4:16384,k5:0:16384,k5:1:16384,k5:2:16384]; the pilot 23-cell enumerator is forbidden
execution_schema_contracts.producer_binding: every artifact binds study id, exact protocol raw and semantic hashes, implementation-freeze hash, producer source commit/tree/file hashes, exact input artifacts, corpus revision, model/revision when applicable, environment, ordered target-key hash, and its complete predecessor evidence; every score/model/study completion additionally binds the committed salt-commitment path/schema/SHA and proves its generator commit descends from the salt-commitment adoption commit
execution_schema_contracts.write_and_resume: write-once target-atomic scores; deterministic compatible resume only; one model-complete reducer per model and one exact four-model study reducer; shard support is frozen but production shard_count is selected before scoring from a target-free dry benchmark
execution_schema_contracts.same_cohort_rule: all four model-complete artifacts contain the exact same ordered 200 target keys and six cell records; required E1a/E2_seed0 cells score all 200, diagnostic contrasts use the identical model-independent structural-eligibility key sets, and no model-specific omission or replacement is allowed

eligibility_and_missingness.all_model_tokenizer_fit_gate: after exact assembly and before any NLL, tokenize every registered prompt with all four pinned tokenizers; any model-position overflow aborts the sealed sample and never triggers redraw or replacement
eligibility_and_missingness.python_dependency_claim: known static dependency context, not complete or optimal dependency context

static_reference_coverage.source: exact extraction graph.target_coverage row joined by target identity
static_reference_coverage.target_fraction: n_resolved_decl/n_refs when n_refs>0, otherwise null and counted separately as no-references
static_reference_coverage.aggregate_reporting: report selected-target counts in every bin plus sums of n_refs, n_resolved_decl, n_module_fallback, n_external, and n_unresolved; coverage never changes or replaces the frozen target cohort

eligibility_and_missingness.budget_scope_qualifier: 16KiB-only dependency-versus-random confirmation; truncation robustness is unassessed

decision_rule_conditions.invalid-provenance-not-analyzed: any protocol, freeze, source, artifact, salt-commitment, model, environment, replay, or ledger binding fails
decision_rule_conditions.cluster-support-inadequate: provenance and the exact sealed sample plan are valid but the pre-score plan has G < 20 or effective G < 10; no score is launched
decision_rule_conditions.execution-incomplete-not-analyzed: provenance and pre-score cluster support pass but exact fixed-N four-model six-cell completion fails
decision_rule_conditions.inference-unavailable-degenerate: primary deltas or SE meet the frozen 64*ulp degeneracy rule or inference is nonfinite
decision_rule_conditions.positive-direction-precision-not-met: primary mean is positive but its realized two-sided 95% halfwidth exceeds 0.02
decision_rule_conditions.e2-positive-confirmed-fresh-sympy-1p5b: all earlier gates pass, one-sided p <= 0.05, and one-sided 95% lower bound > 0
decision_rule_conditions.e2-opposite-direction-descriptive: provenance, exact execution, cluster support, and nondegenerate inference gates pass and the primary point estimate is < 0; the positive-direction 0.02 halfwidth claimability gate does not suppress this descriptive label, and this is not an unregistered negative-direction test
decision_rule_conditions.e2-inconclusive: valid and complete primary not assigned an earlier label

prohibited_claims: pilot plus confirmation treated as N=220
best k5 seed selected after scoring
four checkpoints treated as independent replications
0.02 precision threshold interpreted as an E2 relevance margin
finite four-checkpoint trend called a model scaling law
